name: Guilt
when: Apologising · a change was rolled back

variants.name: Avoid gaze
variants.desc: Won’t meet your eyes. A quick glance back, then away again.

variants.name: Sweat drop
variants.desc: A big drop of sweat slides down while it holds very still.

variants.name: Whistle
variants.desc: Looks up and away, whistling. Nothing to see here.

variants.name: Bow
variants.desc: Bows low again and again, eyes down. Sorry.

variants.name: Shifty eyes
variants.desc: Narrowed eyes darting left and right.
